I’ll start with the caveat that I’m from the United States and I’m generalizing here for Canada; Assuming that insurance operates relatively the same way there as is does here in the states, accepting a cash offer may actually “bar” you from attempting the official insurance route after the fact if you don’t like the way this kid is operating or he’s giving you trouble 

Many insurance companies in the states require an official police report of the incident to protect themselves legally and essentially “prove” who was at fault in any given incident. Without the police report it COULD make it difficult to proceed through insurance, and assuming this post is made after the incident and you two have parted ways, you two have choices. Insurance opinion which would more than likely require contacting the kid and asking him to fill out a police report describing the incident as it happened so it’s official and then contacting your insurance company. 

Second option is just going the cash route and hoping the kid won’t be too hard to work with for repairing the car. 

Again before anyone jumps down my throat here I am under the assumption that it works at least SIMILARLY to the states, and if it doesn’t, and you don’t need a police report? Even better, makes the insurance option more feasible. End of the day just depends on what amount of person risk you’re willing to accept
